l01.title: Molten Wave Oval Ring
l01.descriptionHtml:
Three molten strands, one oval of light. Three smooth molten gold tone strands sweep across the finger and fan apart, and the finest of them curls around a clear oval cut cubic zirconia of about 5 x 7mm in slim claws.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone on the index finger, where the strands can be seen.

Details

  • Stone: One clear oval cut cubic zirconia, approximately 5 x 7mm, held by the curling strand and slim claws
  • Design: Three molten strands, from a fine one to a bold one of about 2.5mm, covering about 15mm of the finger at the widest
  • Size: Open wrap, adjusts to fit US 5 to 9
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

l02.title: Marquise Molten Bar Ring
l02.descriptionHtml:
A cut stone beside a poured line. This open ring sets a clear marquise cut cubic zirconia of about 5.5 x 11mm in four claws beside a long, chunky molten gold tone bar, both following the band, so the two lie side by side across the finger in the toi et moi form.

STYLING TIP: Wear it on the middle or ring finger, where the bar can reach past both edges of the finger.

Details

  • Stone: One clear marquise cut cubic zirconia, approximately 5.5 x 11mm
  • Bar: A smooth molten bar, approximately 25mm long and 2.5mm thick, reaching past both sides of the finger
  • Size: Open, adjusts to fit US 5 to 9
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

l03.title: Twin Cluster Open Ring
l03.descriptionHtml:
Two small clusters, facing each other. A wide, flat open band of polished gold tone ends in two clusters of clear cubic zirconia that meet across the top of the finger: a large pear with two round stones on one side, and two pears with their points turned outward and a small round on the other.

STYLING TIP: Two clusters that meet across the top of the finger: wear it alone on that hand.

Details

  • Stones: Six clear cubic zirconia: three pears and three rounds
  • Clusters: Approximately 10 to 12mm across each
  • Band: Wide and flat, approximately 10 to 12mm wide
  • Size: Open, adjusts to fit US 6 to 8
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

l06.title: Baroque Pearl Duet Ring
l06.descriptionHtml:
A pearl and a polished pebble. This open ring sets a long, ridged baroque shell pearl of about 15 x 7mm in a fine gold tone rim, beside a smooth polished gold tone nugget, the two side by side, each running along the finger.

STYLING TIP: Let it be the only ring on that hand: the pearl and the gold tone nugget already make the pair.

Details

  • Pearl: One baroque shell pearl, approximately 15 x 7mm, in a fine gold tone rim
  • Nugget: Polished gold tone, approximately 12 x 6mm
  • Size: Open, adjusts to fit US 5 to 9
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
